Package model.description

Class DEditableStatement

java.lang.Object
model.description.DEditableStatement
public class DEditableStatement extends Object
An editing-aspect or cloak of a described statement. Provides functionality for editing and navigating a particular one of a theorem's statements. Statements added to a theorem are otherwise often considered fixed but sometimes one wants to go back and edit for example the description part.
